name: Sakura Gym Girls: Prologue
source:
This visual novel is about Kitagawa Shouhei, a university student, who lives in Tokyo with his girlfriend, the energetic and cheerful Sakizaki Ranko. Shouhei and Ranko are still in the early stages of their relationship, and they’re utterly in love.

Everything seems to be going well between Shouhei and Ranko – until Ranko discovers, to her horror, that Shouhei’s doting ways have led her to packing on the pounds.

In an attempt to keep fit, Ranko sweet-talks Shouhei into joining the local gym with her, so she can shed some of the weight she gained while eating all of Shouhei’s home-cooked meals.

Join Shouhei and Ranko in this cute, light-hearted story, which serves as a prelude to a larger series, which will introduce even more cute girls for Shouhei to spend time with!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2018930/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
大學生Kitagawa Shouhei和女友Sakizaki Ranko住在東京。Ranko活力十足、性格開朗，兩人正處於戀情初期，彼此深愛。

Shouhei和Ranko的感情似乎進展順利，直到Ranko驚恐地發現，Shouhei對她的百般寵愛讓她胖了不少。

為了保持身材，Ranko甜言蜜語地說服Shouhei陪她去當地健身房，好減掉那些因吃Shouhei親手做的飯菜而增加的體重。

跟隨Shouhei和Ranko，體驗這段可愛、輕鬆的故事。本作是更大型系列的序章，後續還會有更多可愛的女孩加入，讓Shouhei能與她們共度時光！

[引自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2018930/]Steam[/url]]
